Post-Surgery Rehabilitation Physiotherapy in Nashik

Structured, home-based recovery plans after Total Knee Replacement (TKR), Total Hip Replacement (THR), ligament reconstructions, and fracture surgeries.

Understanding Post-Surgery Rehabilitation

Recovery after joint replacement, ligament reconstruction, or fracture surgery depends heavily on structured, consistent physiotherapy. Early mobilization, guided strengthening, and progressive functional training help restore independence and reduce complications during the healing period.

Home-based care avoids the added strain of clinic travel during the vulnerable early recovery phase, allowing patients to heal in a familiar, comfortable environment while still receiving hands-on clinical supervision.

Who May Benefit

  • Patients recovering from Total Knee Replacement (TKR) or Total Hip Replacement (THR)
  • Post-ligament reconstruction surgery patients
  • Patients recovering from fracture surgery
  • Elderly patients for whom clinic travel post-surgery is difficult or risky

Our Treatment Approach

Rehabilitation is sequenced according to your surgical protocol and recovery timeline — from early mobilization and pain management through to progressive strengthening and functional retraining like walking and stair climbing. Every plan follows the same structured process:

  • Clinical Assessment — evaluating post-operative range of motion, strength, and mobility
  • Custom Treatment Plan — a recovery roadmap aligned with your surgeon's post-operative protocol
  • Interactive Home Visits — hands-on mobilization and supervised exercises at your bedside
  • Recovery Monitoring — tracking milestones and progressing intensity safely

What to Expect at Home

Sessions run about 45 to 60 minutes and combine hands-on treatment with supervised, progressive rehabilitation exercises. Portable equipment is brought to your home, and scheduling is coordinated around your recovery needs, including early morning or evening slots.
